note: The user-facing claims register (program WS-7 task 9). scripts/eval/claims.mjs extracts every claim-shaped string a user can read (frontend copy through the TypeScript compiler, the backend's user-facing C# literals) and holds the tree to this file: every extracted string must be registered here, either in a claim family or in notClaims; every registered text must still be in the tree (an edited claim is re-audited, never silently dropped); every family names its owner and the tests that fail when the claim and the code diverge, and every test named must exist. A family is 'true' (checked against the code, pinned by its tests), 'false' (the code does not do what the copy says: a defect owned by 'owner', counted by the surface harness as a false copy claim until the copy or the code changes), or 'unverified' (the sweep could not establish it from the code; the owner owes the test). Audited 2026-10-26 against build/trust-v1 @ 20429ff.
